about.title: BORN TO RUN FAR.
about.bio1: I am an ultra runner specializing in the longest, most demanding races on the planet. From the frozen trails of the Lappland Arctic Ultra to the endless alpine ridges of SwissPeaks 700K, I seek out challenges that test every dimension of human endurance.
about.bio2: My journey in ultra running has taught me that the body is capable of far more than the mind believes. Crossing 515 km of frozen Lapland wilderness, pulling a sled at -30°C for nearly seven days — these experiences reshaped my understanding of limits.
about.bio3: I carry that philosophy into my coaching, helping athletes of all levels unlock their potential and cross finish lines they once thought impossible. When I am not on the trail, I am a husband and a dedicated coach. Running is not just a sport — it is a way of life.

milestone.eiger: Eiger Ultra Trail E250 by UTMB

coaching.title: GO FURTHER.
coaching.lede: Personalized ultra running coaching built on real experience — not theory. From your first 50K to your biggest dream race.
coaching.philosophyLead: I have run 700 km in a single race. 515 km through the Arctic at -30°C. The lessons from those experiences cannot be found in a textbook.
coaching.philosophy1: Every athlete is different. Your training plan should reflect your life, your body, and your goals — not a generic template downloaded from the internet.
coaching.philosophy2: I coach because I believe everyone deserves the feeling of crossing a finish line they once thought was impossible. That is what ultra running gave me, and it is what I want to give back.

plans.title: Training Plans
plans.desc: Custom periodized programs built around your race calendar, lifestyle, and current fitness. From 50K first-timers to 500K+ veterans.

race.title: Race Strategy
race.desc: Pacing plans, gear selection, and nutrition protocols tested across hundreds of hours in the mountains. No guesswork, only experience.

support.title: 1:1 Support
support.desc: Weekly check-ins, workout analysis, and direct messaging. You are never alone on the trail or in your preparation.

process.step1Desc: We start with a deep conversation about your running history, goals, schedule, and the races you want to target. No templates — everything is built from scratch.
process.step2Desc: I build your training program around your life, not the other way around. Structured weeks that build progressively, with flexibility for when life happens.
process.step3Desc: Training begins. We review every week together, adjusting intensity, volume, and focus based on how your body responds. The plan evolves with you.
process.step4Desc: Full race-week support: final prep, pacing strategy, nutrition timing, and mental cues. After the race, we debrief and plan what comes next.

coaching.ctaBody: Send me a DM on Instagram to discuss your goals and how we can work together. No commitment — just a conversation.
